10 apps parse with expectedFactsSchema; every expected key has a citation; all cited paths exist in the pinned trees

summary: 10 apps labeled from source, all NOT_COMPATIBLE: nightscout (MongoDB), audiobookshelf (SQLite, mounted volumes), glance (mounted config), InvokeAI (GPU, local disk), kubero (SQLite, Kubernetes), DNN (Windows, SQL Server), openpanel (ClickHouse), akhq (Kafka), OpenSearch-Dashboards (OpenSearch), rancher (Kubernetes).
notes: SQLite, Kafka, Kubernetes, SQL Server and persistent-volume causes have no UNSUPPORTED_FAMILIES tag, so unsupported is set only for mongodb, other-database (ClickHouse) and elasticsearch.
openpanel worker=true is a judgment: the queue consumer is the separate apps/worker app with its own Dockerfile.
